newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline tumbles, buying into U.K. dries up.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline tumbles, buying into U.K. dries up.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices ended sharply lower on Friday after NYMEX gasoline tumbled, buying into the U.K. appeared to dry up and the arbitrage looked close to shutting again, traders said.
"It seems at this stage that most U.K. players have filled their tanks, particularly the retailers," said one broker.
Buying from one Scandinavian producer, which was seen as meeting commitments ahead of the U.K. budget, also appeared to cool off, traders said.
Eurograde barges last traded at $224 Amsterdam-Rotterdam, off about $8, after earlier deals at $228.50 Rotterdam running refinery material and earlier prices near $230, traders said.
Regular unleaded barges also fell $8 and were heard offered at $215 fob ARA.
Cargoes fell about $5 to $230/$232 cif and one broker said the arbitrage had closed for prompt material but looked open for deliveries later this year.
